diff_summary: Both event-specific and scheduled dispatch now claim PENDING/RETRY rows through DISPATCHING before consumption.
Event-specific dispatch runs in a new transaction after the event transaction commits.
Immediate failures are contained and returned to PENDING; scheduled failures retain retry/DEAD behavior.
Scheduled runs recover DISPATCHING rows older than the bounded configurable threshold.
